description: Open a pull request for an issue from your fork branch. Verifies the branch exists, is ahead of upstream, and (on DCO repos) that every commit carries a Signed-off-by line. Composes the PR title and body (Closes #N plus verdict and gates at open time). DRY RUN BY DEFAULT: returns the composed PR without opening it unless execute is true; opening requires GITHUB_TOKEN.

branch.description: Fork branch to open the PR from, e.g. feat/resume-61

execute.description: Open the PR for real. Defaults to false: dry run returns the plan only.

issue_url.description: Full GitHub issue URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123

title.description: PR title override. Defaults to the branch's latest commit subject or the issue title.

name: open_pr
